incidents.name: FlyLong public balance-writing controls
incidents.notes: FlyLong exposes tokenMarketing() and tradingTake() to any low-BNB-balance caller, letting the attacker forge the pair's FlyLong balance inside a Pancake flash-swap callback and satisfy the pair's K check without repaying.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim 0x9cA66a67dC3d77bEb59DC11cAf96677843797c08 created 2023-11-28T19:17:34Z by 0x09dd0143103203110b69e2b07ef4f7bc8be6be5b, which is not the attack-tx sender 0xd4e11065267421f88c0cf7a7791d84d8fdd7d42b; 0 EIP-1967 Upgraded events on the victim before the incident; code age measured from deployment (onchain). 1.73 BNB x $606.17/BNB at the incident timestamp 1745886459 (DefiLlama coingecko:binancecoin) = $1,049.
